name: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses
description: DAAD offers fully funded postgraduate scholarships for students from developing countries to pursue Masters degrees at German universities in development-related fields.

name: Chevening Scholarship
deadline: October 2026 (2027/28 intake; expected 7 October 2026, opens August 2026)
description: Chevening is the UK government's flagship international scholarship programme. It offers fully funded Masters scholarships to outstanding emerging leaders from Pakistan.

name: Commonwealth Scholarship (Masters & PhD)
description: Funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office, these scholarships allow talented people from Commonwealth countries including Pakistan to pursue Masters and PhD studies in the UK.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
description: Erasmus Mundus scholarships fund top Pakistani students to study integrated Masters programmes delivered by international university consortia across Europe.

name: Fulbright Scholarship Pakistan
description: The Fulbright program is the US government's flagship international exchange program. Pakistani students can pursue fully funded Masters and PhD programs at top US universities.

name: Türkiye Burslari (Turkey Government Scholarship)
tests_accepted: No English test required for Turkish programs
description: Turkey's government scholarship program offers fully funded Bachelor, Masters, and PhD scholarships for international students including Pakistanis at top Turkish universities.

name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
description: The Chinese Government Scholarship offers fully funded opportunities for Pakistani students to pursue undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs at over 279 Chinese universities.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships
benefits: Health cover for self and dependents
description: Australia Awards Scholarships are long-term development awards offered by the Australian Government for Pakistani students to undertake full-time Master's or PhD study in Australia.

name: MEXT Japan Government Scholarship
description: Japan's Ministry of Education offers fully funded scholarships for Pakistani students to study at Japanese national universities. No Japanese language knowledge required — training is provided.

name: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
description: Hungary's Stipendium Hungaricum program offers fully funded scholarships to Pakistani students for Bachelor, Masters, and PhD programs at Hungarian universities.

name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
description: The Swedish Institute offers fully funded Masters scholarships for Pakistani students to study at Swedish universities, focusing on future leaders with work experience.

name: Korean Government Scholarship (KGSP/GKS)
description: South Korea's Global Korea Scholarship fully funds Pakistani students for undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs at Korean universities with free Korean language training.

name: OeAD Austria Government Scholarship
description: OeAD provides government scholarships for Pakistani students to study at Austrian public universities with free or minimal tuition and a generous monthly stipend.

name: HEC Overseas Scholarship for PhD
description: Pakistan's Higher Education Commission funds PhD scholarships at world-class universities in USA, UK, Germany, Australia, and other countries for Pakistani nationals.

name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship France
description: The Eiffel Excellence Program by Campus France offers fully funded scholarships to outstanding Pakistani students for Masters and PhD programs at top French institutions.

name: Orange Tulip Scholarship Netherlands
description: The Orange Tulip Scholarship is offered by Dutch universities and the Netherlands Education Support Office for meritorious Pakistani students to study in the Netherlands.

name: Italian Government Scholarship (MAECI)
benefits: Tuition fee exemption at public universities
description: The Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs offers scholarships for Pakistani students to study at Italian universities, with free tuition at public institutions and a monthly stipend.

name: Finland University Scholarships
university: Finnish Universities (University of Helsinki, Aalto, etc.)
benefits: Partial tuition waiver or full tuition
description: Finnish universities offer merit-based scholarships for Pakistani students covering partial or full tuition for Masters programs. Finland has high-quality education with affordable living.

name: SINGA Singapore Scholarship (PhD)
description: SINGA is a prestigious PhD fellowship program at Singapore's top research universities and institutes, open to Pakistani students with strong STEM backgrounds.

name: New Zealand Scholarships (NZAS)
description: The New Zealand Government Scholarship supports Pakistani students to pursue Masters and PhD studies at New Zealand universities, fostering development-focused research.

name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarship
description: The Vanier CGS is one of Canada's most prestigious doctoral fellowships, awarded to top international PhD candidates including those from Pakistan.

name: DAAD Helmut Schmidt Programme (Public Policy)
description: The Helmut-Schmidt-Programme funds Masters degrees in public policy and related fields for future leaders from developing countries including Pakistan.

name: Stipendium Hungaricum PhD Scholarship
description: Stipendium Hungaricum fully funds PhD studies in Hungary for Pakistani students with strong academic backgrounds across all disciplines.

name: Malaysian Government Scholarship (MPC)
description: Malaysia offers government scholarships for Pakistani students for Masters and PhD programs at top Malaysian public universities with affordable living costs.

name: Czech Republic Government Scholarship
description: The Czech government offers fully funded scholarships to Pakistani students for all degree levels. Public universities in Czech Republic charge no tuition fees.

name: Norway Quota Scholarship
benefits: Norwegian State Educational Loan Fund support
description: Norway offers free tuition at all public universities. Pakistani students can apply for degree programs and receive student loan/grant support through Lånekassen.

name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
description: The Gates Cambridge Scholarship funds outstanding postgraduate students from outside the UK to study at the University of Cambridge. Pakistani students with exceptional academics and leadership potential are eligible.

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship
university: Swiss Universities & Federal Institutes of Technology
description: The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship provides fully funded PhD and postdoctoral research opportunities at top Swiss universities and research institutions for Pakistani scholars.

name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship (University of Toronto)
description: The Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship at the University of Toronto is Canada's most prestigious undergraduate award, covering tuition, books, and residence for four years. 37 scholarships are available annually for outstanding international students including Pakistanis.

name: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme
description: The Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme provides postgraduate scholarships for outstanding students from developing countries including Pakistan, on a 50% grant and 50% loan basis. Contact local AKF Pakistan office for exact deadline.

name: Rotary Peace Fellowship
university: University of Bradford UK, Uppsala University Sweden, University of Queensland Australia, University of North Carolina USA, Chulalongkorn University Thailand, International Christian University Japan
description: Rotary Peace Fellowships offer up to 50 fully funded Masters fellowships annually at top peace study centres worldwide. Open to all nationalities including Pakistan. Requires 3 years of related work experience.

name: Schwarzman Scholars Program (Tsinghua University)
description: Schwarzman Scholars is a one-year fully funded Masters program at Tsinghua University in Beijing, designed to build a global community of future leaders. Open to all nationalities including Pakistan. Applications for the 2027-2028 cohort open April 2026.

name: KAIST International Student Scholarship
university: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)
description: KAIST, South Korea's top science and technology university, offers fully funded scholarships for international undergraduate, Masters, and PhD students. All programs are taught in English. Strong focus on STEM fields.

name: Government of Brunei Darussalam Scholarship
description: The Government of Brunei Darussalam offers fully funded scholarships for international students including Pakistanis to pursue undergraduate and postgraduate studies at Brunei universities.

name: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship and Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
deadline: November 30, 2026 (for Spring 2027 intake); open to top-10% Bachelor's graduates
description: ETH Zurich's prestigious Excellence Scholarship (ESOP) supports outstanding international Master's students with a full tuition waiver and CHF 12,000 per semester grant. Open to top-10% graduates worldwide including Pakistan. Applications open November 1–30 each year.

name: Rhodes Scholarship for Pakistan 2027
fields: All Fields (full-time postgraduate study at Oxford)
benefits: Economy-class airfare to and from Oxford
Visa and health surcharge costs covered
description: The Rhodes Scholarship for Pakistan funds two outstanding students each year for full-time postgraduate study at the University of Oxford. Applications for the 2027 cohort opened 1 June 2026 and close 5 August 2026 (23:59 PKT). Covers all fees, an annual stipend, airfare, and visa costs.

name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars Program 2027 (Stanford University)
fields: All Fields (any full-time graduate program at Stanford)
monthly_stipend: Stipend for living and academic expenses
benefits: Full tuition for up to 3 years of any Stanford graduate degree
Living stipend and academic expense allowance
Annual travel stipend to and from Stanford
Leadership development through King Global Leadership Program
Up to 100 scholars selected globally each year
description: Knight-Hennessy Scholars funds up to three years of any full-time graduate degree at Stanford University (MS, MBA, MD, JD, PhD, and more). Open to citizens of all countries including Pakistan. Applications for the 2027 cohort close 6 October 2026; applicants must also apply separately to their Stanford graduate program.

name: Clarendon Fund Scholarships 2027 (University of Oxford)
fields: All Fields (all full-time and part-time masters and DPhil courses)
monthly_stipend: ~1,250 GBP (annual grant of at least 15,009 GBP)
deadline: December 2026 / January 2027 (varies by Oxford course deadline)
benefits: Annual living-cost grant of at least 15,009 GBP
Over 200 new scholarships awarded each year
No separate application — automatic consideration with Oxford application
Open to all nationalities and all subjects
description: The Clarendon Fund awards over 200 fully funded graduate scholarships annually at the University of Oxford, covering full course fees plus a generous living grant. Applicants from Pakistan are automatically considered by applying to Oxford by the December 2026 or January 2027 course deadline for 2027 entry.

name: Yenching Academy of Peking University Scholarship 2027
deadline: Early December 2026 (2027 intake; recruitment opens September 2026)
description: The Yenching Academy of Peking University offers a fully funded interdisciplinary Master's in China Studies to around 120 students worldwide, including Pakistan. It covers tuition, accommodation, a monthly stipend, airfare, and health insurance. Recruitment for the 2027 cohort is expected to open in September 2026 with a deadline in early December.
